methodology: Articles sourced from Virginia-specific RSS feeds and Google News RSS, filtered for AI/technology/workforce relevance, then assessed by Claude against the scenario framework. Each article is tagged with the region it most affects and the scenario it signals toward.

signals.title: Roanoke College launches WorkAI Lab to prepare leaders for new era of technology - Roanoke College
signals.signal_reading: Roanoke College's WorkAI Lab represents institutional investment in deep AI literacy outside major metros, potentially activating peer learning networks that could distribute capability beyond NoVA's concentration.

signals.title: Norfolk native brings free AI workshops to Hampton Roads to close the technology gap - WTKR
signals.signal_reading: Free community AI workshops in Hampton Roads signal grassroots capability-building efforts that could create distributed depth, though sustainability and advancement beyond introductory skills remains uncertain.

signals.title: New partnership between VCU and AI Ready RVA aims to boost AI education, innovation and community impact - VCU News
signals.signal_reading: VCU's partnership with AI Ready RVA concentrates AI education infrastructure in Richmond's metro hub, deepening regional capability while the community impact language suggests limited distribution mechanisms to surrounding areas.

signals.title: Virginia's AI boom quietly drained the entire regional electricity grid - Yahoo Finance
signals.signal_reading: Grid-draining data center expansion in NoVA creates infrastructure burden and cost externalization that may inhibit distributed AI adoption elsewhere while concentrating shallow platform-layer benefits in a single region.

signals.title: Virginia Tech secures $20m NSF grant for AI-enabled semiconductor lab - Cleanroom Technology
signals.signal_reading: Virginia Tech's $20M NSF semiconductor AI lab deepens technical capability in Blacksburg but signals research-institution concentration rather than broad workforce distribution across Southwest Virginia's transitioning economy.
